caption: The drawing features a pattern composed of interlocking rectangular and square shapes, primarily rendered in shades of brown and tan, with dark brown outlines. Within the geometric shapes, there are repeated motifs of small, stylized plant or flower forms, each consisting of a stem and multiple oval leaves. The background areas within the rectangles are filled with subtle, wavy or zigzag lines, adding texture to the composition. The pattern is set inside a roughly centered, smaller square section, which is itself surrounded by a larger, lightly penciled square border. The paper has a beige tone, and in the bottom right corner, there is an inscription that reads "Federal Art Project-W.P.A. of Va. by Mary Humes."
title: Material from Dress
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
